text:
incidents-bot: [P1] Elevated 5xx and gateway timeouts detected in prod (service=api-gateway). 5xx rate 10.9% over 5m, timeouts increasing. Alert graph: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/xyz/gateway-errors?from=now-15m

deploy-bot: Auto-deploy paused; recent rollout at 2026-03-20T08:40Z.

maria_oncall: I'm taking the page. Can we get customer impact summary and whether this correlates to any change in traffic pattern?

support_liaison: Support is seeing ~22 tickets in last 30m reporting 502/504 on /v1/chat and /v1/generate. Top accounts flagged: AC-119, AC-470. Notified their CSMs.

raj: From gateway logs, upstream responses are 502 with message "upstream read timeout". Model-proxy backends in eu-west show high socket wait. Also some 503s where tcp reset observed.

sre_jules: I'm on backend pool investigation. eu-west-1b model-proxy-2 shows 3x median CPU for p95-99 requests and goroutine dumps show long block on external KV lookup. No recent infra deploys.

lisa_prod: rolling back last config? The canary applied a new connection pool tuning yesterday. Any chance that caused synthetic load?

infra_ops: No config change in infra in the incident window. The connection pool change was in model-proxy config but rolled out last night; it passed canary. Could be interaction with traffic shape now.

maria_oncall: Immediate mitigation steps: (A) drain problematic host(s) from rotation (B) increase APM sampling for model-proxy to capture traces (C) enable short-term enhanced logging to get request_id correlation (D) enable fallback-model policy for heavy requests. Who can do A fast?

sre_jules: I can start draining the two hosts in eu-west-1b now. Taking them out of LB.

infra_ops: done draining those hosts. Observability: 5xx rate down to 6.8% (5m), but still above baseline.

raj: We're missing request_id in model-proxy logs for a majority of traffic. Gateway x-request-id is present but not passed upstream consistently. That's our observability gap.

maria_oncall: OK prioritize quick log correlation stopgap. Options: 1) enable gateway passthrough of X-Request-Id to upstream (fast) 2) temporary sidecar to tail proxy access logs and emit JSON enriched with x-request-id 3) increase trace sampling. Do (1)+(3) now, and implement (2) asap.

lisa_prod: toggling feature flag: upstream_x_req_passthrough = true -> enabled.

telemetry-bot: APM sampling change requested by sre_jules. Current sampling model-proxy: 0.01 -> 0.6 for 30m.

raj: also starting a fluentd/td-agent job in the cluster to pick up nginx/access logs and add the x-request-id->upstream_status mapping, then ship to dev-ops index. Config snippet: 
```
<filter **>
  @type record_transformer
  <record>
    request_id ${record["http_x_request_id"] || record["x_request_id"]}
    upstream_status ${record["upstream_status"]}
  </record>
</filter>
```

sre_jules: launching the sidecar via a daemonset with nodeSelector for eu-west nodes. Should be live in ~2m.

support_liaison: updated customers: "We're investigating request failures and have temporary mitigations in place. We'll update within 30 minutes."

infra_ops: routing policy adjusted: divert 25% of incoming /v1/generate to warm fallback variant (smaller model) to reduce upstream latency.

maria_oncall: live metrics: 5xx 4.2% (5m) after reroute + sampling increase. Still seeing sporadic spikes correlated to specific backend instances. Any logs with request_id now?

raj: Yes — sidecar is shipping enriched logs. Example: {"time":"2026-03-20T09:12:31Z","x-request-id":"req-9f2e7","upstream_status":"504","msg":"upstream timeout","backend":"model-proxy-eu-2"} — we can map those to gateway ids.

sre_jules: trace snapshots show KV lookup latencies spiking to 250-400ms under contention on a subset of keys. Hypothesis: eviction storm combined with heat on certain keys. We'll throttle parallel KV fetches and add local LRU buffer in next release.

maria_oncall: plan for next 60 minutes: maintain sampling 0.6, keep sidecar logging active for 1 hour, run throughput tests against warm pool, and create a remediation ticket for permanent request_id emission at the app layer. Assign follow-ups.

lisa_prod: I'll prepare a customer-facing timeline and quality note. Notifying product/legal for the higher touch accounts.

telemetry-bot: Incident created INC-2026-0320-21 severity=P1 (creator: maria_oncall).

support_liaison: posted interim update to #customer-status.

raj: I pushed a small iwarm change to model-proxy pool that reduces concurrent KV gets from 10->3 for these hosts as a hotfix. Rolling to eu-west; monitor effect.

infra_ops: after the hotfix, p95 latency drops and 5xx rate now 1.6% (5m).

maria_oncall: excellent. Handoff: sre_jules will monitor for 45m, then raj will take over follow-up. Please add permanent tasks: (a) emit request_id in model-proxy logs (b) default APM sampling policy review (c) KV client backpressure and cache warmup tuning.

sre_jules: noted and creating follow-up tickets. Captured log excerpts and trace ids in INC-2026-0320-21.

maria_oncall: closing the active page in 30m if stable. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

support_liaison: customer impact summary for ticket: peak 11% 5xx on /v1/generate and /v1/chat; high-impact accounts AC-119, AC-470; mitigations: drain hosts, fallback model, kv backpressure hotfix, enhanced logging to restore traceability.

telemetry-bot: sampling revert scheduled: model-proxy sampling will revert to 0.01 at 2026-03-20T10:30Z unless extended by on-call.

sre_jules: last check (20m): 5xx = 0.8% steady, sidecar captured ~520 correlated traces. Moving to monitoring mode.

maria_oncall: great work. I'll make the postmortem owner assignment and close the incident once traces and tickets are linked.
